response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad engineering experience with genuine high-throughput credentials (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second at Sociomantic/dunnhumby, low-latency async D services) and, critically, current hands-on work with agentic AI infrastructure — MCP code generators and frameworks supporting agentic workflows at re:cinq — which maps directly to the role's AI-native baseline expectation. Strong TypeScript/Node depth, a craftsmanship/TDD culture background, and demonstrated ownership as an open-source founder round out the profile. The main gap is Python: it appears nowhere in his skills or job history, while the JD lists 'strong Python' as a must-have with TypeScript only at working level — effectively inverting his stack. Recent roles also skew product/full-stack rather than distributed-systems architecture, and there is limited explicit evidence of technical strategy at scale, cross-functional stakeholder management, or on-call/incident ownership. Worth an interview to probe Python proficiency and staff-level scope, but those two areas should gate the decision.
strengths: Real high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of req/sec, low-latency async services)
Current hands-on agentic AI infrastructure and MCP tooling work — matches AI-native baseline
Deep TypeScript/Node expertise plus strong engineering-craft practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based)
concerns: No evidence of Python anywhere in resume, despite being a stated must-have
Distributed-systems depth is dated (2018–2020); recent work is product/full-stack oriented
Little demonstrated technical strategy at scale, stakeholder management, or on-call ownership
